tier_a.title: ExpWeaver: LLM Agents Learn from Experience via Latent RAG
tier_a.hook: Encodes agent experiences as LLM hidden states, retrieves in latent space via cross-attention. SOTA on 12/13 tasks, +6.8% over baselines, token-efficient, strong cross-domain transfer.

tier_b.title: SARAF: Stationarity-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Time Series Forecasting
tier_b.hook: Retrieval-augmented TS forecasting with diversity-aware selection modulated by dataset stationarity. Best gains under non-stationary conditions.

tier_b.title: KVarN: Variance-Normalized KV-Cache Quantization for Reasoning Tasks
tier_b.hook: Calibration-free KV-cache quantizer: Hadamard + variance normalization. 3-5x capacity at 2-bit with FP16 accuracy on MATH500/AIME24. Single vLLM flag.

tier_b.title: Predict and Reconstruct: Joint JEPA + MLM for Self-Supervised Representations
tier_b.hook: Hybrid JEPA prediction + MLM reconstruction on shared encoder. More uniform embeddings (< -0.16 vs -0.05) with same downstream accuracy.

tier_c.title: LoomVideo: Unified Video Generation and Editing
tier_c.hook: 5B-param MLLM + Deepstack injection for DiT. Half the compute of 13B competitors.

tier_c.title: Linear Probes Detect Task Format, Not Reasoning Mode
tier_c.hook: 100% probe accuracy drops to chance after controlling for format confounds.

tier_c.title: Query-based Cross-Modal Projector for Mamba Multimodal LLM
tier_c.hook: Cross-attention compresses visual tokens for Mamba LLMs; no 2D scan order needed.

tier_c.title: Predictable Scaling Laws for Continued Pre-training Hyperparameters
tier_c.hook: Optimal LR and batch size follow stable power laws as compute budget grows.

tier_c.title: RUBAS: Rubric-Based RL for Agent Safety
tier_c.hook: 4-dimension safety decomposition for fine-grained reward in tool-use scenarios.

tier_c.title: LatentWave: JEPA Pretraining for Wireless Foundation Models
tier_c.hook: JEPA applied to wireless signals; learns transferable representations via latent masking.

tier_c.title: CodeGolfBench: Concise Code Generation Benchmark
tier_c.hook: Multi-language benchmark; reasoning LLMs achieve 70.97% percentile in conciseness.

tier_c.title: Hedge-Bench: Financial Reasoning for Agents
tier_c.hook: 102 real-world financial tasks; frontier models score under 16%.

news.title: Anthropic confidentially filed for IPO at $965B valuation
news.summary: Surpasses OpenAI valuation. Also secured 300 MW of compute at xAI Colossus 1 for $1.25B/month through May 2029.

news.title: Google I/O 2026: Gemini 3.5 Flash, Gemini Omni, Gemini Spark
news.summary: Flash rivals large flagships on coding/agentic benchmarks. Omni does any-to-any generation. Spark is a 24/7 personal agent.

news.title: SpaceX plans to acquire Cursor post-IPO
news.summary: Option expected to be exercised in July, roughly 30 days after SpaceX begins trading publicly on June 12.

already_ported.description: Retrieval augmentation for time-series forecasting with stationarity awareness. RAG-for-TS is now well-explored.

unported.technique: Latent experience retrieval via cross-attention at decoding time
unported.hypothesis: Encoding past diagnostic reasoning as latent states rather than text summaries could reduce context-window pressure for ECG/PPG analysis agents while improving diagnostic consistency.

unported.technique: Hybrid JEPA prediction + masked reconstruction pre-training
unported.target_domain: Sensor foundation model pre-training (SSL for HAR, biosignal FMs)
unported.hypothesis: Combining JEPA prediction loss with masked reconstruction for sensor data could produce more uniform representations that generalize better across diverse downstream health tasks.
